from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTotalLiabilities(BaseModel):
    """Total liabilities reported in a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company from the filing")
    total_liabilities_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total liabilities amount as reported in the filing (before unit conversion)")
    liabilities_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Date of the financial statement period end")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial filing, e.g., 'Form 10-Q'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_total_liabilities: list[CompanyTotalLiabilities]
